title: TranscriptResult
description: The output of the transcript pipeline.

lang.description: The language of the chosen track; null unless status is ok.

source.description: The kind of the chosen track; null unless status is ok.

word_count.description: Words of all pages together; 0 unless status is ok.

truncated.description: Whether the text was truncated; false unless status is ok.

sponsor_ratio.description: Sponsor share of the video; null unless ok, and when SponsorBlock failed.

pages.description: The paginated transcript; empty unless status is ok.
